verdict.rationale: WezTerm's own Lua config API provides `wezterm.on`, which registers a user-defined callback that runs automatically when a named event is emitted. That is a first-party event-to-action rule mechanism matching the story's core. The evidence is a single doc line, though: it does not enumerate which events exist or show what actions callbacks can take. Missing for 10: documented catalog of available events, examples of the actions callbacks can trigger, independent or hands-on corroboration of event-driven automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: `wezterm.on` causes your specified `callback` to be called when `event_name` is emitted.
